description: Fail-closed admission authority for future client/server compatibility windows. It defines how an iOS or Portal client and an approved backend release may become an admissible skew pair; the contract itself creates no support claim and current empty approved-release/client registries imply zero admissible pairs.
forbiddenPromotionSources: test binary digest without reviewed client baseline
marketing or UI version string without artifact digest
manual compatibility assertion without exact pair evidence
requiredPairEvidence: exact approved client artifact digest and approved backend release artifact digest
old-client/new-server authenticated read and write journeys
new-client/old-server authenticated read and write journeys when previous backend is claimed supported
session issuance and resolution across the supported skew
persisted Apply replay/idempotency across the supported skew
account deletion fencing across the supported skew
offline resume or retry semantics for any supported offline client state
negative tests for client versions below the minimum support boundary
negative tests for backend versions outside the admitted rollback boundary
reviewed retirement/expiry behavior that does not silently widen support
limitations: no approved production backend release exists
no client/server skew pair is currently admissible
this foundation does not claim iOS or Portal runtime implementation
candidate-only mixed-version backend evidence cannot manufacture client support
